welcome.title: Cognitive Function Assessment Suite
welcome.instructions:
• Find a quiet, comfortable space free from distractions

• Each test includes clear instructions before starting

• Complete each test at your own pace

• Results are calculated immediately after each assessment

• You may take breaks between tests as needed

test_selection.title: Cognitive Function Assessment
test_selection.subtitle: Select a test to begin cognitive evaluation
test_selection.about_text: This assessment suite evaluates various aspects of cognitive function including attention, memory, processing speed, and executive function. Each test is designed to measure specific cognitive abilities through standardized tasks. Results are calculated immediately upon completion of each test.

stroop.name: Stroop Test
stroop.description: Identify the color of text while ignoring the word itself

reaction_time.name: Reaction Time Test
reaction_time.description: Measure how quickly you respond to a stimulus

dms.name: DMS Test
dms.description: Remember a sample stimulus and identify it after a delay

instructions.stroop: In this test, you will see color words displayed in different colors. Your task is to identify the COLOR of the text, not the word itself. You will complete 20 trials. Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.
instructions.dms: A sample image will appear briefly (it will be visible for around 0.8 seconds). After it disappears, four images will be shown. Your task is to select the image that matches the original. Only one image is correct. Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.

stroop.instructions: Press the key corresponding to the COLOR of the word. Ignore the text itself. R = {red}, G = {green}, B = {blue}. Press any key to continue.
stroop.export_hint: Choose a format and save your results to a file.

dms.setup_hint: Choose how long the sample image should stay visible.
dms.export_hint: Choose a format and save your results to a file.

common.placeholder: Test logic will be implemented here.
